title: Localization of same-horizon active-irrigation temporal discrepancy

depends_on.RM23: same-horizon one-step versus two-half endpoint difference available
depends_on.RM24: inherited global 1e-5 cm head budget not transferable
depends_on.RM25: active-irrigation temporal acceptance contract defined but quantitative authority blocked

question: Where in the SWAP column does the independently observed one-step versus two-half temporal discrepancy live, and how large is the discrepancy in coupling-relevant lower-interface state and total column storage?

frozen_case.initial_profile: identical RM23 -75 cm top-origin hydrostatic profile

required_outputs: global max endpoint pressure-head difference and node/depth where it occurs
maximum pressure-head difference over the lowest 20 percent of nodes
maximum pressure-head difference over the upper 20 percent of nodes
signed and absolute total-column storage difference in cm water
hypotheses: The global max pressure-head discrepancy is spatially localized and need not represent the fixed-interface state discrepancy.
The same-horizon trajectories preserve the imposed surface and bottom transfer identities even when internal pressure-head profiles differ.
Column-storage discrepancy is a more directly conservation-relevant measure than global max pressure head for the current one-window coupling purpose.
failure_rule: Do not introduce an acceptance threshold in RM26. Do not alter the solver, forcing, boundary conditions, horizon or sequence after seeing the result. RM26 is localization evidence only.
nonclaims: RM26 does not admit the triangle.
RM26 does not define a replacement temporal tolerance.
RM26 does not claim that lower-interface similarity is sufficient for long-term hydrological-memory fidelity.
